Passport Size Photo Maker

This passport size photo maker online tool crops your picture to the official 35 × 45 mm ratio and exports it at 413 × 531 pixels (300 DPI) on a white background — the size used for Pakistani passports, CNIC-related forms and most visa applications.

🔒 Your files never leave your device.

How to use

  1. Choose a clear front-facing photo with a plain background if possible.
  2. Adjust the zoom slider so your face fills the frame the way you want.
  3. Press Make passport photo and download the 413 × 531 px JPG.

How it works

Passport photos are 35 mm wide and 45 mm high. At print quality (300 DPI) that is 413 × 531 pixels. The tool centre-crops your picture to the 35:45 ratio — keeping the face area — and places it on a white background at exactly that size.

Worked example: Example: a normal selfie cropped with zoom 1.4 usually frames the head and shoulders correctly for a 35 × 45 mm print.

Frequently asked questions

What is the passport photo size in Pakistan?

35 × 45 mm, which is 413 × 531 pixels at 300 DPI. This is the size this tool produces.

Can I use this photo for online forms?

Yes — the JPG is sized for both printing and uploading. If a form also has a KB limit, run the result through our Image Compressor to KB tool.

What background should a passport photo have?

A plain white background is the standard requirement. Take your photo against a white wall for the cleanest result.

Is my photo uploaded anywhere?

No. The crop is made in your browser; your files never leave your device.
